headlines.title: Watch: Spain witnesses first total solar eclipse in 27 years
headlines.description: NBC News’ Raf Sanchez reports on the ground in Spain as crowds revel and cheer at the total solar eclipse taking place during the sunset hour.

headlines.title: Crowley thanks supporters after winning Democratic primary for Wisconsin governor
headlines.description: David Crowley spoke to supporters after pulling off a win in a close Democratic primary for Wisconsin governor against Francesca Hong.

headlines.title: Sen. Darline Graham and Rep. Ralph Norman advance to GOP Senate primary runoff in South Carolina
headlines.description: Graham, the sister of the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, will face another Republican in an Aug. 25 runoff for the party’s nomination, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Sen. Darline Graham and Rep. Ralph Norman advance to GOP Senate primary runoff in South Carolina
headlines.description: Graham, the sister of the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, will face another Republican in an Aug. 25 runoff for the party’s nomination, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Minnesota GOP picks Lisa Demuth over Trump-backed Mike Lindell for governor against Democrat Amy Klobuchar
headlines.description: Demuth, the state House speaker, defeated Trump-endorsed Lindell for the Republican nomination, NBC News projects, while Klobuchar romped in her primary.

headlines.title: Democratic Rep. John Larson loses his primary to opponent calling for generational change
headlines.description: The 14-term Connecticut Democrat lost to former Hartford Mayor Luke Bronin in a heavily blue district, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Nick Reiner indicted on murder charges in the stabbing deaths of his parents Rob and Michele Reiner
headlines.description: Nick Reiner has been indicted on murder charges in the deaths of his parents, Rob and Michele Reiner, in a stabbing attack inside the family’s Brentwood home in December.

headlines.title: Lakers to be sold to Bob Iger and Josh Kushner for $12 billion
headlines.description: The Los Angeles Lakers are being sold to an ownership group led by Josh Kushner and former Disney CEO Bob Iger reportedly for a $12.5 billion. NBC News' Steve Patterson reports on the new ownership group buying the franchise that had just been bought in late 2025.

headlines.title: Trump Addresses Elaborate Plane Swap Ruse to Keep Him Safe
headlines.description: New comments from President Donald Trump confirm that he secretly swapped planes as he left an international summit because of a threat from Iran. A U.S. official tells NBC News that the threat included the possibility of the Iranian regime targeting the president with a shoulder-fired missile. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Send your questions for Keir Simmons as he reports from Saudi Arabia
headlines.description: Keir Simmons has covered the Iran war from the beginning, including attending negotiations in Pakistan and Switzerland.

headlines.title: Bumble scraps signature rule and now allows men to make first move on dating app
headlines.description: Dating app Bumble announced on Tuesday that it would be getting rid of its hallmark rule that prevents men from making the first move.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.
